title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What’s going on with that job?
Had my interview on Wednesday with the VP of Marketing and still waiting to hear back.
It went alright. Somehow me being an ordained minister came up but it turns out the VP's sister went to divinity school so I looked like an asshole lol
Are you an ordained minister in the way that I had to do training to marry my friends?
How did you look like an asshole lol
Yeah, I could officiate your wedding lol
I looked like an asshole just because her sister did all this training and I just went online to get a similar title haha
